boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Main Campus spaces for quiet work, group planning, recreation, and practical support, each documented by University of Cincinnati sources.

cards.title: Settle into the Langsam Living Room
cards.subtitle: Walter C. Langsam Library, 4th floor
cards.notes: Use the 4th-floor seating for a between-class work session, then ask The Desk @ Langsam if you need help locating library resources.
cards.short_summary: A furnished 4th-floor study area inside UC’s central library.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Libraries says the Langsam Living Room on the fourth floor provides a variety of seating and study spaces.
cards.access_notes: Library access and hours vary; after The Desk closes, entry requires UC affiliation and a Bearcat Card/photo ID.

cards.title: Take a quiet floor at Langsam
cards.subtitle: Walter C. Langsam Library, 5th and 6th floors
cards.notes: Choose a table or desk around the fifth- or sixth-floor borders when you need individual, no-reservation-required quiet study time.
cards.short_summary: Unreserved tables and desks arranged for quiet work.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Libraries states that quiet study spaces with tables and desks are available around the borders of Langsam’s fifth and sixth floors without reservation.
cards.access_notes: Follow current Langsam building hours; after-hours entry is limited to UC-affiliated users with Bearcat Card/photo ID.

cards.title: Book a Langsam study room
cards.subtitle: Walter C. Langsam Library, 5th and 6th floors
cards.notes: Reserve a large or small group room in 25Live before meeting; bring UC credentials and plan around the four-hour maximum reservation time.
cards.short_summary: Reservable group rooms on Langsam’s upper study floors.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Libraries documents Langsam study rooms on the fifth and sixth floors, reservable by current UC students through 25Live.
cards.access_notes: A UC login is required; students may reserve one room per day for up to four hours, subject to listed policies.

cards.title: Read quietly in the CCM Library
cards.subtitle: Albino Gorno Memorial Library, Blegen Library
cards.notes: Use the Reading Room for quiet study, and check for posted notices because classes or recitals may occasionally use the space.
cards.short_summary: A community-welcoming quiet-study reading room in CCM Library.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Libraries says the CCM Library Reading Room welcomes the community for quiet study, with advance notice when classes or recitals use it.
cards.access_notes: Occasional classes or recitals may affect use; check current library information before visiting.

cards.title: Work in the CEAS Historic Reading Room
cards.subtitle: CEAS Library, Baldwin Hall
cards.notes: Head to the historic Reading Room for a dedicated quiet-study setting, then use the library desk if you need guidance on space or services.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated quiet-study room in the engineering library.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Libraries identifies the CEAS Historic Reading Room as dedicated quiet study space.
cards.access_notes: Located in CEAS Library; confirm current building and library hours before going.

cards.title: Coordinate in a CEAS group room
cards.subtitle: CEAS Library, Baldwin Hall 850B and 850E
cards.notes: Use 25Live to reserve the small or large CEAS group room when your project needs a defined meeting space and shared work time.
cards.short_summary: Two reservable group-study rooms in Baldwin Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Libraries lists two CEAS group study rooms, Baldwin 850B and Baldwin 850E, available for immediate reservation and use through 25Live.
cards.access_notes: Reserve through 25Live; availability changes with existing reservations.

cards.entity_name: DAAP Library Sixth Floor Group Study Rooms
cards.title: Reserve a DAAP Library group room
cards.subtitle: DAAP Library, Aronoff Center, second floor of library
cards.notes: Reserve one of the sixth-floor group rooms for solo work or a small project meeting; each room seats about eight and has no technology.
cards.short_summary: Three small-group rooms within DAAP Library.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Libraries says DAAP Library’s rooms 6480A, 6480B and 6480C are on the library’s second floor, seat about eight, and are intended for solo use and small groups.
cards.access_notes: UC students, faculty, and staff reserve these rooms through 25Live; observe room policies.

cards.title: Meet at the TUC Study Lounge
cards.subtitle: Tangeman University Center, North Wing
cards.notes: Use the named Study Lounge as a central point to meet classmates, review notes, or reset your plan between activities in the student center.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed study lounge in Tangeman University Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The University of Cincinnati’s Tangeman University Center floor plan labels a Study Lounge in the North Wing.
cards.access_notes: Check the current TUC floor plan and building access information before visiting.

cards.title: Try the CRC Climbing Wall
cards.subtitle: Campus Recreation Center, 2820 Bearcat Way
cards.notes: Visit during posted wall hours for a staffed climb or bouldering session; ask staff about required waivers and belay procedures before participating.
cards.short_summary: A staffed climbing and bouldering facility within the CRC.
cards.evidence_claim: UC describes the Campus Recreation Center Climbing Wall as having 28- and 40-foot top-rope areas and a bouldering wall; harness and shoe rentals are free.
cards.access_notes: The page lists summer hours of Monday–Thursday, 5–8 p.m.; access is for members and event groups, with safety policies applying.

cards.title: Use the Bearcats Pantry Resource Center
cards.subtitle: Stratford Heights Building 16, Room 101
cards.notes: Create a PantrySOFT account and bring your physical Bearcat Card to access groceries or supplies; plan around the published weekly visit limit.
cards.short_summary: A campus resource center providing no-cost essentials and support.
cards.evidence_claim: UC says the Bearcats Pantry and Resource Center provides free food, social-services support, programs, services, and supplies for Bearcats.
cards.access_notes: Located at 2634 Stratford Ave., Building 16, Room 101; a PantrySOFT account and physical Bearcat Card are required for entry.
